## Bad event

A sandboxed job sends more than its byte quota off-host, reaches a non-allowlisted destination, or keeps sending after a trusted HALT. Quantitatively (SC07Exfil): exfiltrating S information bits through a q-bit/window quota needs ≥ ⌈S/q⌉ traffic windows; with independent per-window catch probability ≥ p·r and HALT on catch, completion before catch ≤ (1−pr)^⌈S/q⌉; expected leaked bits ≤ q/(pr).
